Product source: d8569a457c217c2fd961340dd1b4a914a5a8e962.
Release and verification date: 2026-10-03 (Asia/Shanghai).

- Windows NSIS archive integrity passed. Installer and payload versions are 3.15.1; payload architecture is x64.

- macOS DMG integrity passed. Info.plist versions are 3.15.1; the Mach-O includes x86_64 and arm64 with non-ad-hoc CMS signature structures.
- The user confirmed the Mac package uses the same product source and passed installation, startup, DuMate switching, Developer ID signing, and notarization checks. Native Mac checks were not independently executed on the Windows host.
- The user confirmed Windows manual verification passed. Detailed platform logs are not yet supplied; this is not a claim of an independently verified clean-machine matrix.
- Frontend: 77 tests passed and production build passed.
- Windows Rust: 121 tests passed, 1 pre-existing test ignored; rustfmt and Clippy with warnings denied passed.
- Dependency license metadata: 295 npm packages and 546 Rust crates passed the project checks.
- Merge-commit CI and dependency advisory results must be recorded separately before the tag is pushed. Local checks do not substitute for those results.

## Windows signing exception for this version

The Windows installer is unsigned (`Get-AuthenticodeSignature`: `NotSigned`).
After being informed of the signature requirement and the unsigned status, the
user's latest instruction on 2026-10-03 was:

> 我想起来了 windows下没有签名 按规范执行

This release proceeds with the existing unsigned Windows package under that
version-specific instruction. The website and release notes disclose this
limitation. No general signing requirement is removed, and no self-signed
certificate is substituted for a trusted publisher signature.

The exact frozen file sizes and SHA-256 values are in `v3.15.1.md` and
`v3.15.1-checksums.txt`. The website and GitHub Release must publish these same
files without rebuilding or overwriting an already-public asset.
